title: ARM PMIC I2C voltage/frequency register write (CLKscrew pattern)
description: PMIC I2C address 0x60 at offset 0x00000003 followed by register 0x77 write with value 0xF8. This matches the CLKscrew ARM DVFS attack pattern where voltage or frequency is manipulated via I2C to the PMIC to induce transient faults.

details.technique: CLKscrew ARM DVFS / PMIC I2C manipulation

recommendation: Audit PMIC I2C access control. Restrict kernel drivers from performing arbitrary PMIC register writes. Validate DVFS operating points against SoC safety margins.

title: Flash descriptor signature anomaly
description: Intel flash descriptor signature (0x0FF0A55A) not found at expected offsets or within first 4KB. Descriptor may be missing or corrupted.
recommendation: Verify flash image integrity and check for descriptor corruption.

title: Invalid MBR signature
description: MBR does not end with 0x55AA boot signature. May be corrupted or tampered.

title: INT 13h IVT hook detected
description: INT 13h vector points to ABA4:9D96 which is outside BIOS ROM range. This is a strong indicator of a bootkit.
recommendation: MBR bootkit detected. Restore MBR from clean backup.

title: Suspicious AMD microcode equivalence table
description: AMD microcode container at offset 0x00000019 has anomalous equivalence table: table_size 0x4D000000 exceeds 0x2000. This may indicate a tampered or injected AMD CPU microcode update.
recommendation: Validate AMD microcode containers against AMD vendor signatures. Check PSP-signed update capsule integrity.

title: No boot application measurement in event log
description: Expected at least one EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION event. Its absence may indicate the event log is incomplete or truncated.

title: No Secure Boot variable measurement in PCR[7]
description: Expected EV_EFI_VARIABLE_DRIVER_CONFIG events in PCR[7] for Secure Boot policy. Absence may indicate the event log was tampered with to hide policy changes.

title: BlackLotus: Revoked MOK key enrolled in firmware
description: MokList at offset 0x00000020 contains a hash matching known-revoked BlackLotus bootkit signer. This allows loading arbitrary code bypassing Secure Boot.
recommendation: Clear MOK database and apply latest UEFI dbx revocations

title: BlackLotus: Baton Drop policy with integrity checks disabled
description: BCD policy at offset 0x00000420 contains integrity disable flag (0x10000007). This is the CVE-2022-21894 'Baton Drop' exploit used by BlackLotus to bypass Secure Boot.
recommendation: Apply KB5025885 Windows update and rotate Secure Boot keys

title: BlackLotus: Multiple shimx64.efi references (persistence indicator)
description: Found 4 references to shimx64.efi in firmware image. BlackLotus installs multiple copies of shim in non-standard paths for persistence.

title: Invalid SPI flash descriptor signature
description: Expected descriptor signature 0x0FF0A55A, found 0x00000000. SPI flash descriptor may be corrupted or modified.
